r6_findings.minimal_fix: Do not treat Controller-written dispatch/reviewer/tester/P0 artifacts as independent evidence. Require Paseo-server-signed or separately executed evidence, bind Gate 5.9 to digests of all raw reviewer/tester/P0 evidence, and anchor approvals externally.

r6_findings.title: Review gate enforces two seats/different agentId/registered artifacts, but caller can fabricate dispatch and reviewer history
r6_findings.observed: 4/4: A_REVIEW_PASS without evidence rejected; duplicate agentId rejected; fabricated dispatch via public recordIntent/recordAck/recordTerminal + registered raw artifacts + REVIEW_SEAT_RECORDED passes A_REVIEW_PASS; same for B_REVIEW_PASS. The checks are Controller-internal consistency, not Paseo server authentication.
r6_findings.residual: A caller with Store access can create fake dispatch/ACK/TERMINAL and reviewer artifacts; physical Paseo execution is not independently attested.

r6_findings.title: Ed25519/trust-root/time/Gate binding works; nonce is not consumed and real operator identity is still not attested
r6_findings.observed: 15/15: valid Ed25519 proof accepted; wrong task/gate/digest/actor/receipt, tampered signature, stale/future timestamp, trust-root SHA mismatch all rejected; valid Controller.approve Gate 0.1 advances; Gate 5.9 proof binds/rejects substituted final-compliance SHA. However, the same valid nonce is accepted twice by verifyHumanApproval; no nonce consumption ledger exists for Gate approvals (recovery has an explicit event check). Actor identity is a string; trust-root env/private-key protection remains deployment responsibility.
r6_findings.residual: Replay prevention for Gate approvals relies on the state machine, not a nonce ledger. Real operator identity is NOT_VERIFIED.

r6_findings.title: Store Gate 5.9 re-checks Git object/ancestry/HEAD and P0 HMAC/job/commit/physicalId/model/dispatch
r6_findings.observed: P0 direct 15/15: valid HMAC passes; tampered MAC/jobId/commit/physicalId/model/harness/exitCode/clean/stdout hash/PASS+findings/HIGH comments rejected; distinct physical inventory accepted; duplicate physicalId/key content rejected. Store Gate 5.9 calls verifyCommitEvidenceSync; official R6-004 direct Store test passes. Real remote 5bao/9bao/rusty P0 not contacted.

r6_findings.title: Constructor rejects gitVerifier injection and Store uses imported verifier
r6_findings.observed: Official R6-005 test passes: new Store(...,{gitVerifier:()=>true}) throws; monkeypatched property is ignored; fake SHA still rejected. No independent bypass found.

r7_findings.title: Public dispatch/artifact/history APIs can fabricate both Reviewer seats and pass A/B_REVIEW_PASS
r7_findings.repro: Seed A_REVIEW; recordIntent(A1-review-spec_reviewer), recordAck(job, fake-agent-spec), recordTerminal(job); register raw reviewer artifact; append REVIEW_SEAT_RECORDED. Repeat for quality_reviewer with a different agentId. save A_REVIEW_PASS succeeds. Same for B_REVIEW_PASS.
r7_findings.impact: The independent double-review gate is only a Controller-internal record check; a caller with Store access can skip real review and still satisfy A/B_REVIEW_PASS. This is the residual of R6-002.
r7_findings.minimal_fix: Require Paseo-server-signed reviewer evidence or an independently authenticated dispatch receipt bound to the exact commit/phase/agentId; do not accept Controller-written dispatch rows as proof of external execution.

r7_findings.title: Gate 5.9 human signature authenticates final-compliance.json, not Reviewer/Tester/P0 raw evidence provenance
r7_findings.observed: The Gate 5.9 statement binds final-compliance.json SHA; final compliance is built from Controller fields/artifacts. Reviewer/Tester/P0 raw reports are only locally hashed; the human does not sign their digests, and a caller can fabricate them.
r7_findings.impact: A valid human final approval can bless fabricated review/test/P0 evidence; signature authenticity does not imply execution authenticity.
r7_findings.minimal_fix: Bind the final Gate statement to a Merkle root of all raw reviewer/tester/P0 evidence and require external execution receipts; or have the P0/Reviewer services sign their own reports.

r7_findings.title: Human approval nonce is not consumed; same signed envelope is accepted twice
r7_findings.observed: verifyHumanProof accepts the same nonce twice. Gate state transitions prevent a second same-gate transition in normal flow, and recovery explicitly checks prior recoveryNonce events, but Gate 0.1/0.2/5.9 approvals have no nonce ledger. A DB restore/replay attack is not prevented by nonce alone.
r7_findings.impact: Replay protection is state-machine-dependent, not cryptographic nonce consumption. The task explicitly asks for nonce replay testing.
r7_findings.minimal_fix: Persist consumed nonces (task, gate, keyId, nonce) atomically with the Gate transition and reject duplicates; keep the recovery nonce check.
